Claim: direct maintainer dispatch (直派) from a cloud-repo session — not a lane round. domain:cli seat was VACANT at R74 close-out (04:49Z) when this was claimed; repo-level events in the preceding 90 min show the active session working domain:skills, not cli.

Clause-②: no — the change adds an optional field to a local CLI credential file (`CloudConfig` in `packages/cli/src/utils/cloud-config.ts`) and a flag fallback. No key reaches a published payload; no contract accepts or refuses anything it did not before.

Dispatching one `os-dev` to a dedicated worktree now. Card body carries the full measurement; every line number in it was verified against `origin/main` before the card was written.
